objective: Add an Effects control that offsets the Terrarium DEM depth value without moving visible geometry.

assumptions.positive_value: moves Terrarium DEM depth closer to the camera
assumptions.negative_value: moves Terrarium DEM depth farther from the camera
assumptions.input_crs: EPSG:3857 Web Mercator for viewer terrain coordinates

outputs: Biased WebGL fragment depth for Terrarium DEM rendering

parameters.terrariumDepthBiasMeters: User text input parsed as a finite number, defaulting to 0 when invalid
parameters.step_controls: - and + controls modify terrariumDepthBiasMeters in 1 meter increments

geospatial_data.rasterization_resolution: Unchanged selected Terrarium LoD mesh resolution
geospatial_data.per_pixel_aggregation_rule: Unchanged; this effect does not modify DEM sampling
geospatial_data.validity_mask: Not applicable to raster metrics; applies to rendered Terrarium fragments

visualization.formula: visible clip = projection * view * position; depth clip = projection * vec4(viewPos.xy, viewPos.z + biasScene, 1.0); gl_FragDepthEXT = clamp(depthClip.z / depthClip.w * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0)
visualization.info_modal: An Effects information button shows the GLSL snippet used to calculate the biased fragment depth.

commands.command: Headless browser smoke test with Node runtime and Playwright

warnings: This is visualization-only and does not change DEM data or metric calculations.
Meter conversion follows the viewer horizontal scene scale because the WebGL scene is normalized and vertically exaggerated.
errors: Headless browser smoke test could not run because the Node runtime does not have the playwright module installed.
